about.title: About TMistan
about.p1: TMistan is the official platform for searching and exploring trademark records published in Afghanistan Official Gazette.
about.p2: Our mission is to provide public access to reliable trademark information to support businesses, legal professionals, and the public.

features.officialSub: All data is sourced from Afghanistan Official Gazette.
features.verifiedSub: Every record is verified and linked to its source.
features.imagesSub: View trademark logos in high resolution.
features.searchSub: Powerful search and filters to find trademarks quickly.

help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: How to search the registry and read a trademark record.
help.a1: Type a mark name, applicant, serial number (e.g. 1011-002), gazette number (e.g. 1011) or a goods description into the search box. Use Advanced Search to combine Class, Gazette, Applicant, Application Type and Date Range filters.
help.a2: The serial number identifies a trademark within a gazette issue — “1011-002” is the second record published in Gazette 1011. Together with the gazette number it uniquely identifies the record.
help.a3: A registry administrator has checked the transcribed record against the printed gazette page. Records that are not yet verified are still shown, with their review status.
help.q4: Where does the data come from?
help.a4: Every record is transcribed from an issue of the Official Gazette of Afghanistan. The Source Information block on each record page names the gazette, page, source file, sheet and row.

g.class: Class — one of the 45 Nice Classification categories of goods (1–34) and services (35–45).
g.gazette: Gazette — an issue of the Official Gazette in which trademark applications are published.
g.objection: Objection deadline — the last date on which a third party may oppose the application.
g.applicant: Applicant — the person or company that filed the trademark application.
g.attorney: Attorney / Representative — the agent acting for the applicant.

legal.terms: TMistan reproduces trademark publications from the Official Gazette of Afghanistan for research and information purposes. The printed gazette remains the authoritative publication. Records are provided as transcribed; TMistan makes no warranty as to completeness or accuracy and accepts no liability for decisions made on the basis of this information.
legal.privacy: Public pages of TMistan do not require an account and do not collect personal data beyond standard server logs. Administrator accounts are used only to maintain the registry. No data is sold or shared with third parties.
